subject: Activation path: procurement paperwork, billing start & trial success criteria
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jared Liao <jared@skylineai.com>, Maya Thompson <maya@skylineai.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (procurement + trial)

Hi Jared / Maya — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment: 

Key points from call:
- Goal: validate Skyline's model-safety & retrieval use case in production traffic patterns, then convert to paid capacity.
- Primary procurement preference stated: corporate PO ideally; card for quick pilots if procurement timeline slips.
- Marketplace: interest low priority now, possible later for procurement consolidation.
- Success criteria you mentioned: sustained 100k tokens/day, average generation latency < 500ms P95 for standard prompts, and integration with your internal logging pipeline.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) I attached a short SOW (Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.pdf) and a Trial Success Criteria spreadsheet (trial-success-criteria.xlsx) — please confirm/edit the cells under "pass/fail thresholds".
2) Procurement: can you confirm whether Skyline requires a vendor packet (W-9 / W-8, insurance, vendor questionnaire) before issuing a PO? If so, please attach or indicate the portal link.
3) Trial start date: we can provision a dedicated trial environment as soon as we receive sign-off on start date — proposed window: week of Nov 23. Does that work?
4) Billing: do you prefer billing to begin on the calendar trial start date, or to be triggered once the trial crosses the usage thresholds? (We can accommodate either, will document in order form.)

Attachment: Redwood-SOW-draft-v1.pdf (15KB stub)
Attachment: trial-success-criteria.xlsx (8KB stub)

Thanks — cc'ing Vivek (SE) and Marissa (commercial lead) to loop them in for pricing/contract logistics.

-Connor
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Maya Thompson <maya@skylineai.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Jared Liao <jared@skylineai.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (procurement + trial)

Thanks Connor — quick answers inline.

On Mon, Nov 16, 2026 at 2:05 PM Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Key points from call:
> - Goal: validate Skyline's model-safety & retrieval use case in production traffic patterns, then convert to paid capacity.
> - Primary procurement preference stated: corporate PO ideally; card for quick pilots if procurement timeline slips.

Procurement: correct — preferred is PO via our AP system. We will need your vendor packet (company legal name, tax form, COI/insurance details). Our vendor intake form is here: https://procure.skylineai.com/vendor-intake (you can upload docs).

Marketplace: we might consider GCP Marketplace later but not a blocker for this pilot.

Success criteria (confirming numbers):
- Target throughput: ~100k tokens/day for the pilot (aggregate across teams).
- Latency: P95 < 500ms for 512-token prompts.
- Integration: server-side logging to our ELK stack; Redwood must expose structured logs (JSON) or provide a delivery mechanism.

Trial start: Nov 23 works for us, tentative. Can you hold that date?

Billing trigger: procurement will accept start-of-service billing on the PO effective date. However, for internal approvals we would prefer billing to start upon PO confirmation (so if PO issuance lags, we may request a limited trial period with no billing until PO is signed). Would Redwood be willing to set billing start to either (a) PO effective date or (b) explicit go-live toggle we control?

Also: can you share your SOC 2 report and a sample order form (or link to DocuSign)? Jared is on copy to help move vendor intake.

Regards,
Maya Thompson
Head of Platform Integrations | Skyline AI
maya@skylineai.com | +1 (646) 555-7890

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Maya Thompson <maya@skylineai.com>, Jared Liao <jared@skylineai.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Discovery recap & next steps (procurement + trial) — pricing & contract ask

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding Maya's note. Action items I need from Commercial/SE: 

- Marissa: can you prepare PO vs card pricing memo and outline standard PO payment terms (net30, billing start on PO effective date vs trial toggle options)? Include any common concessions for pilot customers (e.g., deferred invoice until PO is received).
- Vivek: can you confirm we can expose structured logs for Skyline's ELK pipeline and estimate engineering time for initial integration (1-2 week estimate ok). Also confirm we can meet the latency target P95 < 500ms at 100k tokens/day with the suggested model configuration; if not, propose a plan.

Quoted from Maya below for context: 
> Procurement: correct — preferred is PO via our AP system. We will need your vendor packet (company legal name, tax form, COI/insurance details). Our vendor intake form is here: https://procure.skylineai.com/vendor-intake (you can upload docs).
> 
> Trial start: Nov 23 works for us, tentative.
> 
> Billing trigger: procurement will accept start-of-service billing on the PO effective date. However, for internal approvals we would prefer billing to start upon PO confirmation (so if PO issuance lags, we may request a limited trial period with no billing until PO is signed). Would Redwood be willing to set billing start to either (a) PO effective date or (b) explicit go-live toggle we control?

Also note they want SOC2 and a sample order form. Attaching the SOW + success criteria again.

Thanks — let's aim to have a draft PO memo + SOC2 link to send by EOD Wednesday.

-Connor

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Maya Thompson <maya@skylineai.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & next steps (procurement + trial) — PO options & next steps

Connor / Vivek / Maya — thanks for the clear notes. Quick summary from Commercial and next steps we will execute: 

1) PO vs card pricing: we will honor the same unit pricing for PO as for card pilots. Standard PO terms: Net30 from invoice date. For pilots where the PO is delayed, Redwood can accept a signed Master Services Agreement + a purchase order to lock pricing and defer the first invoice until PO effective date. If Skyline prefers, we can also implement a "go-live toggle" controlled by Skyline to start billing when you flip the toggle. Either approach is acceptable — we'll document in the order form.

2) Vendor packet: attaching a vendor packet bundle link (we will push the docs to your vendor intake portal once you confirm the contact). Please expect: W-9, COI, SOC 2 summary, Redwood vendor questionnaire PDF.

3) SOC2 + security: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted) is available here: https://redwoodinference.com/security/soc2-summary.pdf. For the intake form, we'll also include a short security questionnaire addendum.

4) Trial start & success criteria: Nov 23 tentative is fine. We'll provision the environment and schedule a kick-off with Vivek for integration. On billing start: per above, we will set the order form language to accept either (a) billing start on PO effective date, or (b) billing start on Skyline's explicit go-live toggle. We'll note that auto-billing on threshold exceedance is possible but requires prior agreement in the order form.

5) Next steps / owners:
- Marissa: send order form (DocuSign) + PO pricing memo to Maya and Jared by EOD Wed (attachment: Redwood-OrderForm-sample.docx stub).
- Vivek: schedule kick-off for Nov 24 and provide a short integration checklist (logs, auth, sample payloads).
- Connor: follow up with Skyline on vendor intake upload and confirm final trial start date.

Attachments: Redwood-OrderForm-sample.docx (6KB stub)

Maya — will you confirm who on Skyline will own vendor intake so we can push docs directly?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Commercial Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (650) 555-0204
